title: Higher resolution
description: Draw the game at a larger size than the Switch's docked 1600x900. Costs GPU time and memory.

title: Pulled-back camera
description: Move the in-game camera further from the hero to see more of the area. 1.0 is the game's own distance; 1.5 is a good start. Far values show more fog and may show unloaded edges.

title: Faster heroes
description: Multiply how fast heroes walk, run and sprint. 1.0 is the game's own speed.

title: Seasons (offline)
description: Make a season active without Blizzard's servers, so the Season Journey and seasonal heroes are available. The game's data holds 12 sets of seasonal content that repeat (season 13 is the same as 1), so these are all the distinct choices. Leaderboards and other online parts of seasons stay unavailable.

title: Cheats (for testing)
description: In the game, F1 raises your hero to level 70, F2 adds 100 paragon levels and F3 adds 10,000,000 gold. While the game runs, the Cheats panel below can also add gold and give you any item. Changes are saved with your hero.

title: Mouse
description: Use a mouse or trackpad alongside the controller. In menus, point at an entry to select it and click to choose it; a dialog's Accept and Cancel can be clicked. In the game, hold the left button to walk toward the pointer and hold the right button to use your primary skill (A), which also talks, opens and picks up.

title: Deckard Cain's gems
description: Deckard Cain stands in New Tristram again, up and to the left of the waypoint, and sells custom legendary gems at their highest rank. Each adds a pylon's buff every so many kills while socketed. A hero holding one of these gems needs this mod on to load.
